name: cruscotto
description: Nineties dashboard above the prompt: context, 5-hour and weekly limits, model, tokens per minute, total tokens in millions, and a check-engine lamp.

skin.title: Skin
skin.description: The look of the strip: night (dark themes), amber (one-color nineties cluster), paper (light themes) or mono.

warnAt.title: Amber threshold (%)

buttons.title: Prompt buttons
